citations.quote: An der Badezimmerdecke wächst grau-grüner Schimmel, und im Gang riecht es seit Monaten muffig.
Zudem ist es in den Schlafzimmern jeden Morgen kalt, weil der Heizkessel nachts ausfällt.
Ein solches Gutachten ist aus meiner Sicht unumgänglich.
Ich werde den Mietzins ab Dezember bei der Hinterlegungsstelle hinterlegen, falls die Gerance bis dahin nichts unternimmt.
Vermieterin: Gerance Bärenplatz AG, Obere Bahnhofstrasse 9, 9500 Wil

plan.because: The supplied contract identifies the parties, property and agreed tenancy terms.
The original report to the landlord is needed to establish what was reported and when.
Evidence of when the landlord received the defect report is missing.
Dated objective evidence of the affected locations is missing.
The original response and any proposed work or access arrangements are needed.
Mould is reported; dated moisture and temperature observations are needed.
A heating fault is reported; inspection and service findings are needed.
Health effects are unmentioned and presumed absent for planning, although the factual verdict remains unresolved.
An independent inspection is expressly considered necessary; the cause remains open.
A rent deposit is contemplated; the communicated deadline and notice contents need review.
This document is optional under the process.

questions: When did the mould and heating problems begin, and when and how were they reported to the landlord?
Has a written repair deadline already been sent, and which December is contemplated for the deposit?
Has a heating service or independent inspection taken place? If so, please provide the reports.
Is there an immediate health or safety concern requiring urgent attention?
